Subject: Your anticipatory bail matter - Anticipatory Bail Application No. 683/2019

Dear Mr. Ahuja,

Thank you for meeting us on 20 November 2019 about your dispute with Suresh Kulkarni. As we understand it, the complaint turns a business disagreement into a criminal case.

Our advice is to argue that the dispute is civil in nature and offer to cooperate with the investigation. Please collect the partnership papers and the correspondence with the complainant and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹55,80,000.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor
